focus: Make shadow/edge quality a persisted benchmark invariant and prepare one runner entry point that produces sealed native-4K still, display-diagnostic and temporal evidence without auto-awarding Visual Fidelity points.

substantiveCommits.message: Enforce shadow stability on benchmark save
Bind shadow contract to scene save gate
Add one-shot native 4K review packet runner

shadowPersistence.behavior: On benchmark sceneSaving, once QualityBlock1990s and SummerSun exist, apply then validate the existing StableFit/4-cascade/VeryHigh-shadow/MSAA/LOD policy before save completion.
shadowPersistence.reason: The cinematic/environment chain already applies the shadow pass, but a save gate prevents later benchmark scene edits from silently persisting a lower-quality shadow/LOD state.

renderDiagnostics.input: Actual runtime-produced hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 PNGs plus all manifest 100% crops only
renderDiagnostics.policy: Thresholds are triage warnings only. No automatic Visual Fidelity points or deductions are generated; exact pixels still require human review.

sequence: capture + SHA-256 seal native hero/oblique/grazing stills and pixel-exact 100% crops
capture + seal native-4K subpixel_grazing temporal sequence
capture + seal native-4K lod_walk_oblique temporal sequence
stop before scoring so a reviewer must inspect and record evidence/deductions/corrective actions

implementationReadiness.reason: The remaining readiness blocker is still actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/import verification. New source-side evidence/diagnostic orchestration cannot substitute for that runner result.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.lightingShadowsReflections: Potentially positive because the already-authored StableFit 4-cascade VeryHigh shadow policy is now re-applied/validated on benchmark save, reducing the chance of stale low-quality shadow settings or detached-contact evidence.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.cinematicImage: Potentially positive indirectly because actual 4K post-tonemap clipping/crush statistics will be generated before review, focusing corrections on real highlight rolloff and shadow-separation defects rather than speculative exposure changes.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLodAliasing: Potentially positive because the one-shot review packet produces both required sealed motion probes alongside the still set and preserves the existing MSAA/LOD cross-fade shadow policy.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.criticalDefectRisk: Improves detection rather than auto-clearance: major light leak, severe aliasing/shimmering, visible LOD pop and render-quality-without-render remain impossible to clear from source configuration alone.
